# Contextual bibliography — index

*Generated by `build_index.py`; do not edit by hand. Agent-written cards; the author has not reviewed them.*

470 cards, written in rounds 2–5 (2026-10-13 to 2026-10-15), each re-checked against its source by a second agent: 166 confirmed, 293 corrected in place, 0 could not be verified. 388 rest on a full read and 82 on a partial read, which the card's Read depth line itemises. From round 4 every source cited in DRAFT_v2.md has a card, at the author's ruling; a card that opens with "⚠ Not read in full" rests on a record, preview or reviews only, and claims resting on it are marked unverifiable in `../audit/claims/`.

**Marks.** ✓ confirmed on re-check. ✓* corrected: the verifier found and fixed an error, recorded in the card's S2 section. ⚠ could not verify. A card is listed under the first facet that cites its source.

Places where a full reading disagrees with a facet file are collected in [`../audit/CARD_FACET_CHECKS.md`](../audit/CARD_FACET_CHECKS.md).
